title: Playing at the Park
text:
Tom and Anna are friends. They meet at the park every day. Today it is sunny. Tom has a red ball.

Anna has a blue bike. She rides it to the park. Tom throws the ball, and Anna catches it. They are happy.

questions.text: What does Anna ride to the park?
What can we guess about Tom and Anna?
options: They do not like each other
They do not know the park

questions.text: What can we guess about the way they play?
options: They play together and enjoy it

vocabulary.definition: people you like and spend time with
takes hold of something that is moving through the air

paragraph_translations: Tom ve Anna arkadaştır. Her gün parkta buluşurlar. Bugün hava güneşli. Tom'un kırmızı bir topu var.
Anna'nın mavi bir bisikleti var. Bisikletiyle parka gider. Tom topu atar ve Anna onu yakalar. İkisi de mutludur.
